day_shape: 82 items: IDF confirms killing of Hamas Gaza military chief Izz al-Din al-Haddad, ~100 Hezbollah targets struck over weekend with one IDF officer killed, CENTCOM reports 78 ships redirected under Iran blockade, reports US and Israel preparing to renew Iran war as soon as next week, heavy Khamenei-office and IRIB output, nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: Hamas Gaza military chief killed
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed it killed Izz al-Din al-Haddad, head of Hamas's military wing in Gaza and Mohammed Sinwar's successor, in a Friday airstrike on Gaza City. Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir instructed Southern Command to stay alert for retaliation; Palestinian media reported the funeral had begun.

threads.label: Hezbollah-IDF exchanges in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck around 100 Hezbollah targets across southern Lebanon over the weekend, the first strikes since the Lebanon ceasefire was extended, while Hezbollah launched rockets, mortars and drones at Israeli troops. Cpt. Maoz Israel Recanati, 24, a Golani platoon commander, was killed in a Hezbollah explosive drone attack on Friday.

threads.label: US blockade and possible renewed Iran war
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported that with Iran talks stalled, Israel and the US are preparing to renew the war as soon as next week, and Trump posted a 'calm before the storm' image. CENTCOM said that as of 16 May, 78 commercial ships have been redirected and 4 disabled under the maritime blockade of Iran.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and China diplomacy
threads.summary: Trump said Chinese President Xi agreed Iran must reopen the Strait of Hormuz, though China gave no indication it would act. IRIB cited MS NOW reporting that Beijing rebuffed US requests and 'happily let Trump continue to flounder' on Hormuz.

threads.label: US arms sales and Iran proxy prosecutions
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Secretary of State Marco Rubio approved $25.8 billion in defence arms sales to Israel, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar and the UAE, per Bloomberg. A US Department of Justice criminal complaint against a senior Kata'ib Hezbollah official alleged Iranian proxies may have been behind two March shooting attacks in Toronto.

threads.label: Beit Shemesh explosion claims
threads.summary: Defa Press said a large explosion in Beit Shemesh, west of Jerusalem, occurred at the 'Tomer' missile-development company and claimed Arrow/Pikan surface-to-air missile stocks and ammonium perchlorate were destroyed. The IRGC-linked outlet cited Israel's Kan network and said authorities were preventing ambulances from entering the site.

threads.label: Khamenei-office martyrdom and resistance messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB pushed messaging marking the deaths of General Mousavi and Defence Minister Nasirzadeh, including the 'Martyrs' Families First' campaign and a message describing the 'Islamic Army' in hand-to-hand combat with 'infidelity and arrogance'. Speaker Qalibaf claimed Iran's '70-day resistance' had accelerated a global shift toward the Global South.

events.title_en: Cuba's unfulfilled freedom caught between compromise and economic collapse
events.summary_en: Cuba faces the most severe humanitarian and economic crisis in its history. A generation of young people without memory of the revolution, exhausted by shortages of electricity, food and freedom, and an unprecedented wave of migration has occurred. Cuba is an island in the Caribbean Sea whose history is deeply tied to the concept of 'freedom' and 'struggle for independence'. From the time of Spanish colonialism to American dominance and then the 1959 revolution, Cubans have always sought national sovereignty and liberation from foreign domination. This report reviews these efforts from the fifteenth century to recent events. Christopher Columbus in the year 1492 attributed Cuba to Spain.

events.title_en: Anti-Zionist protests sweep across Europe
events.summary_en: Tens of thousands of people across Europe held protests to mark the seventy-eighth anniversary of Nakba Day. events.summary_en: Breaking: Army and Shin Bet have eliminated the terrorist known as Iz al-Din al-Haddad - commander of Hamas's military wing and one of the last senior Hamas terrorist leaders who stood behind the bloody October 7 massacre. Throughout the war, al-Haddad was involved in the detention of a large number of Israeli hostages, managed the system of hostage detention in Hamas's grip and surrounded himself with Israeli hostages to prevent his elimination.
